title: Seasonal bowl-drop social film

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Build anticipation through a timed reveal so a seasonal launch feels like an event.
strategic_value: A shift from quiet title card to vivid tomato footage can give Sweetgreen’s launch a sensory rhythm.
demonstration: A phone over tomatoes plays an Instagram post: a seasonal title card gives way to close-up tomato footage, brief launch copy and a closing signature.
practical_value: Compare the pacing of a restrained opening card with a moving food reveal in a social placement.

content_islands.name: Social frame
content_islands.spec: Keep the phone and Instagram interface visible over the tomato photograph.

content_islands.name: Launch film
content_islands.spec: Sequence seasonal words, moving tomato imagery, launch information and signature inside the post.

reference_purposes.Application: The complete clip presents a seasonal launch film within a social feed.
reference_purposes.Expression: Close-up tomato motion follows a restrained typographic opening.
